programme.sub-title: Mysteries of the Bible: Unlocked S01E01
programme.desc: Enter a world where craftsmanship meets art at a microscopic level. For the first time ever, high-definition cameras equipped with super-macro lenses reveal the inner workings of some of the most delicate and exquisite timepieces ever created. Two-thousand-year-old-bones may be evidence, never before seen, of an actual crucifixion from the time of Jesus. They may reveal that the classic depiction of Jesus on the cross is not how crucifixions were actually carried out in the 1st Century.

programme.title: Is It Haunted?
programme.desc: On this episode the team investigate the RSS Discovery, RRS Discovery is a barque-rigged auxiliary steamship built in Dundee, Scotland for Antarctic research. Launched in 1901, she was the last traditional wooden three-masted ship to be built in the United Kingdom. Her first mission was the British National Antarctic Expedition, carrying Robert Falcon Scott and Ernest Shackleton on their first, and highly successful, journey to the Antarctic, known as the Discovery Expedition.
